testimonials.name: Raja Sekhar Gowravarapu
testimonials.role: Technical Delivery Lead & Senior Integration Architect
testimonials.feedback:
Anil delivered strong performance throughout 2026, consistently demonstrating technical expertise, ownership, and commitment across multiple business-critical initiatives. He successfully supported and delivered solutions across key channels, including Skymond, Emida, USSD, FMC, Cerillion, Kiosk, Ecare, and MapleWave, contributing significantly to both project delivery and operational stability.

A key achievement this year was his contribution to the MuleSoft 4.9 modernization program. Anil played an important role in migrating APIs to MuleSoft 4.9 and CloudHub, ensuring successful code remediation, testing, validation, and deployment while maintaining platform standards and reliability.

His work on the FMC legacy modernization initiative was particularly noteworthy: he successfully analyzed complex legacy integrations, understood intricate dependency chains, and migrated seven FMC endpoints to MuleSoft 4.9, modernizing critical services while preserving business functionality. He also demonstrated strong expertise in payment management and channel integrations across Cerillion, Liberate, Amdocs, and Emida. Beyond individual delivery, Anil actively supported team success through knowledge sharing, KT sessions, and achieved the MuleSoft Certified Developer certification.
keyHighlights: Migrated 7 Critical FMC Endpoints to MuleSoft 4.9

testimonials.name: Bujjikonda Vedantam
testimonials.source: Capgemini Continuous Feedback · ESB Strategic Conversion
testimonials.feedback:
Anil Rana made significant contributions to the ESB Conversion Program, a strategic initiative that is critical to the customer's resiliency and cloud transformation objectives. He successfully delivered multiple API conversion efforts and played an important role in the successful execution of this high-visibility program for the Liberty Latin America (LLA) customer.

Anil consistently demonstrated strong MuleSoft development expertise, taking complete ownership of his assigned deliverables and ensuring high-quality outcomes. Beyond his individual contributions, he proactively supported team members in resolving technical challenges, showcasing his collaborative mindset and commitment to overall team success.

His excellent communication skills, positive attitude, and ability to work effectively across teams have made him a dependable and valued team member. Anil is a strong team player who readily shares knowledge and contributes to a productive working environment. Overall, Anil's technical capabilities, ownership, continuous learning attitude, and dedication to delivery excellence have made him a valuable contributor to the success of the ESB Conversion Program and the broader LLA integration portfolio.
keyHighlights: Strategic ESB Conversion for Liberty Latin America (LLA)
